label: Fick principle: aerobic supply is at most eta E Q (Ca - Cv)
statement_en: O2 delivered to tissue = cardiac output × (arterial − venous O2 content).

hypotheses.name: fick-principle#assumed-1
hypotheses.statement: conservation of O2 in the circulation; aerobic power only

scope.basis: a theorem about a model: it applies wherever the design supplies the quantities it uses and accepts the hypotheses in scope.assumed Applies to sustained aerobic DEMAND only (scope.applies_to / scope.excludes).
assumed: conservation of O2 in the circulation; aerobic power only
scope.note: Instantiations must use a taxon-appropriate MO2max or cardiac output Q: a borrowed snapper Qmax (58.48 ml min^-1 kg^-1) underestimates small cyprinids about 3x (measured zebrafish MO2max 2630 mg O2 kg^-1 h^-1 at Ucrit, Palstra et al. 2010, PMC3013094; physics/FICK-CEILING-CHECK.md). Oxycaloric equivalent 13.54 J/mg at 0.7 ml O2 per mg (1.429 mg/ml) = 19.34 J/ml.
applies_to: sustained aerobic power DEMAND: powered level flight, climbing flight, and sustained (aerobic) swimming — work the animal must pay for out of metabolism
excludes: unpowered descent or glide: the work comes from potential and kinetic energy, not from metabolism, so W v / (L/D) computed for a descent is NOT a demand this law bounds. A real gliding flying fish compared against this ceiling comes back "violated" only because the caller converted a glide into a level-powered-flight requirement; that is an application error, not a violation (it happened to Park and Choi specimens making realistic glide claims, 2026-11-01).
burst (anaerobic) effort paid out of white-muscle stores, which is what a flying fish is understood to use for take-off and taxiing

non_vacuity_witness.statement: a positive power below the Fick supply with the measured teleost proxies
